title: Co-op: keyboard prompts on the HUD, chord skills for player 2
intro: Main pawn with skills equipped in slots 5 and 6 if he has them. Player 2's controller connected. Open ground.

steps.text: Press End to start co-op on the main pawn
Player 2: press a few buttons and move the stick. Check the button prompts on screen: they should stay KEYBOARD/MOUSE. Press End
Player 2: hold L1 and press SQUARE + CROSS together (skill 5). Let go.
Player 2: hold L1 and press CROSS + CIRCLE together (skill 6). Let go.
Player 2: L1 + Square alone, then L1 + Cross alone (skills 1 and 4 still work)

probes.hid: local m = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserInputManager"); return m and m:call("get_HIDInputMode")
probes.pad: return H.pad_buttons and H.pad_buttons() or nil
probes.chords: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "DPC_coop.json"); return ok and d and d.chords
probes.skips: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "DPC_coop.json"); return ok and d and d.glyph_skips
probes.pskill: local pw = H.pawn(0); local h = pw and pw:call("get_Human"); return h and h:call("get_CustomSkillState")
